component.name: Cursor Mover
component.summary: Keep your computer awake by nudging the cursor

description.p: Cursor Mover is a small tray application that moves the mouse pointer to a random position on a timer, so your machine never registers as idle. No window, no taskbar entry — just an icon you click for a menu.

ul.li: Moves the cursor to a random screen position on a fixed interval
Configurable interval from 10 seconds to 1 hour, remembered between launches
Desktop notifications when movement starts and stops
Runs in the background with no window of its own

description.p: Requires an X11 session. Wayland does not permit applications to move the pointer, so Cursor Mover cannot work under Wayland.

screenshot.caption: The tray menu, showing status and interval

description.p: Adds Windows and Linux support alongside macOS, sharing one tested core.
